prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean UV (tanning beds) or spray tan (sunless)? That will change the best places to recommend.

While you decide, here are quick tips to find the best salon in Tyler, TX and what to look for:

How to find top salons
- Search Google Maps, Yelp, and Facebook for “spray tan” or “tanning salon” + “Tyler TX”. Sort by rating and read recent reviews.
- Check salon websites or social pages for staff photos, before/after photos, pricing and package deals.
- Look for up-to-date hours, easy booking (online or text), and contact information.

What to look for (spray tans)
- Technicians trained/certified with brands like Mystic Tan, VersaSpa or Norvell.
- Clear photo gallery and skin-tone matching consultation.
- Use of hypoallergenic, DHA-based solutions and a patch test offered for first-timers.
- Good ventilation and private booths.

What to look for (UV/bed tanning)
- Clean beds and booths, disposable liners or thoroughly cleaned surfaces.
- Modern, reputable bed brands (look for Ergoline or similar).
- Staff that asks about skin type, medications, tanning history and provides recommended times.
- Card or package pricing and membership options.

Red flags
- Very low prices with poor hygiene or no consultation.
- No masks/eye protection (for spray) or no cleaning procedures (for beds).
- Pushy sales tactics for large, unnecessary packages.

Safety tips
- For UV tanning: follow recommended exposure times for your skin type, wear eye protection, and avoid excessive sessions. Remember UV increases skin cancer risk and accelerates aging.
- For spray tanning: shower/avoid heavy lotions/fragrances before appointment; moisturize afterward to help even fade.

If you want, tell me:
- Which type (spray or UV),
- Your ZIP or neighborhood in Tyler,
and I can give a short list of top-rated salons (based on recent online reviews) plus addresses/hours to help you pick.
